hooks.name: Load project context on session start
hooks.description: At session start, remind Kiro of the current project state, open tasks, and key architectural principles so context is always fresh.

action.prompt:
Session started on the Personal Memory OS project. Load the current context:
1. Read .kiro/specs/personal-memory-os.md to find the next incomplete task
2. Remind yourself: AI calls happen server-side (Lambda → Bedrock), never from Flutter directly
3. Remind yourself: two-layer alarm strategy (EventBridge Scheduler + flutter_local_notifications)
4. Remind yourself: all colors from AppColors, all text styles from AppTextStyles
5. Surface the next actionable task to the user if they haven't specified one
